name: One UI icon count
author: wizard
description: WizardOS Android app: the unread count on the Messenger home-screen icon shows the exact number (up to 999, then 999+) instead of 9+, in a solid orange-red badge with bold white digits, no ring and a faint shadow, about a third of the icon high, at the icon's top-right corner like One UI's own badges (on Samsung pulled in far enough that the rounded icon corner never cuts it).
